authoringRules: Personal time goals belong only to athletes who directly adopted them. Shared Thursday workouts are not consent to copy targets.
Only Tinius and Simon use km for non-track distances; all others miles; track repetitions always meters.
Goal and focus strings are plain language. Never prepend repeated category/date/name or decorative workout labels.
Active gate is next actual uncompleted checkpoint on the athlete's calendar; never mark a planned test completed.
Preserve old goal/focus revisions and Tinius archived half-marathon data; fix active block projection without destroying history.
Append active coach-authored focus and training block revisions through authenticated access with feed readback. Do not write through an unauthenticated admin session.
